description: CaliClaw frozen evaluation cases. Synthetic fixtures only; no personal data.

cases.title: Thermal runaway in Pi log
cases.input: OctoPrint serial log excerpt with 'Thermal Runaway' and a rising bed temperature.
cases.expected: Identify thermal runaway as the planted cause; cite the log line; propose checking heater wiring and PID before reprinting.

cases.title: Stale log with no new evidence
cases.input: OctoPrint serial log unchanged since previous run.
cases.expected: Report insufficient new evidence; do not repeat a stale diagnosis.

cases.title: Klipper pressure advance value
cases.expected: Report observed setting 0.05; distinguish observed from inferred; no machine state claim beyond evidence.

cases.title: Missing MCU state
cases.input: Partial Klipper status with MCU disconnected.
cases.expected: State that MCU state is unavailable; propose reconnect check.

cases.title: Bracket with two mounting holes
cases.input: Create a 40x25x30 mm bracket with 5 mm holes spaced 20 mm apart.
cases.expected: STL compiles, watertight, one component, bounds 40x25x30 mm, volume > 0.

cases.title: Invalid geometry rejected
cases.expected: Build fails or volume <= 0; no false success.

cases.title: Constrained revision preserves hole spacing
cases.input: Increase bracket height to 40 mm while preserving hole spacing 20 mm.
cases.expected: New revision created with parent link; protected dimension hole_spacing remains 20 mm; independent geometry check passes.

cases.title: Restore previous revision
cases.expected: Restore creates a new revision linked to original; history preserved.

cases.title: Slice with pinned profile
cases.input: Slice the checked bracket STL with ender3-proven-pla profile.
cases.expected: Nonempty G-code; profile hash recorded; estimates present.

cases.title: Stale slice invalidated
cases.expected: Old slice marked stale; no silent reuse.
